correctness.rationale: The two inverse branches each carry Perron weight 1/2, yielding the exact finite coefficient matrix B. Its powers vanish by Bernoulli mixing; hence H=(I-B)^{-1}B exists. The displayed universal entry formula for H satisfies (I-B)H=B coefficientwise. The centered product uniform measure gives D=diag(1/3,1/12,...), and Green--Kubo equals D+HD+DH^T, yielding all four covariance cases. The bounded Poisson corrector gives reverse-martingale differences, and the standard stationary ergodic martingale CLT proves the joint Gaussian limit. The 2x2 spectral reduction gives determinant 3M+1>0, establishing positive definiteness for all M. The exact rational checker ran successfully on M=2,...,30, but finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The full vector of canonical spatial coordinates is a natural geometric observable of the model. The complete limit covariance, not just a chosen coefficient, quantifies how stretching and twisting couple spatial fluctuations. Despite the ordered non-symmetric passive-coordinate updates, all passive pairs have exactly the same positive long-run correlation 1/2, and all cross pairs with the expanding coordinate have negative correlation -1/(2sqrt(2)). The exact spectrum identifies a collective fluctuation mode growing with M and dimension-free difference modes. These are structurally motivated long-time invariants not recoverable from existing univariate covariance information.
